fees.joining_note: A one-time joining fee of ₹12500 is charged at the time of card issuance as per the bank's policy.
fees.annual_note: The annual fee is charged every year and may be waived if you meet the bank's spending conditions.
fees.annual_fee_waiver: The annual fee is waived if you spend ₹25 Lakh or more in a year on your card, as per bank policy.

fee_schedule.forex_markup_note: 2% forex markup is charged on transactions made in currencies other than INR. Applies to international POS payments and online purchases charged in foreign currency.Examples (2%):₹100 → ₹2₹1,000 → ₹20₹10,000 → ₹200₹1,00,000 → ₹2,000
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge: As prescribed by IRCTC / Indian Railways
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge_note: Surcharge on booking or cancelling railway tickets will be levied as prescribed by IRCTC or Indian Railways and may vary based on their applicable charges.
fee_schedule.late_payment_note: Late payment charges apply if the Minimum Amount Due (MAD) is not paid by the due date. Charges are based on the total outstanding amount as per the slab structure above.

• Transfer 2 partner miles for every 5 EDGE Reward Points across 20 travel partners, up to 5 lakh EDGE points per calendar year

• 8 complimentary Airport Meet & Greet services per calendar year at 16 airports across India via Extraordinary Weekends, valid for both domestic and international departures and arrivals

• Unlimited complimentary International Lounge Access via Priority Pass Card, 4 additional guest visits per year on Priority Pass
• Unlimited Domestic Airport Lounge Access at select lounges across India
• Minimum spend of ₹50,000 in the previous 3 months required to unlock Domestic Lounge Access
• For newly issued cards, minimum spend criteria is waived for the month of issuance and the following 3 months
